title.description: The code on coded problems, a short heading otherwise.

detail.description: The message: what went wrong, for a person.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable error code (CodedProblems). Absent on older uncoded answers.

field.description: On validation problems: the request field at fault.

reason.description: On validation problems: why the field was refused.

retryAfterSeconds.description: When the request may be retried; the Retry-After header carries the same value.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. Routes may add further members.

allowNested.description: true or false sets it, null clears it, absent keeps it.
